basic_details.job_title: NeGD Security & GRC Lead Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD), an independent business division under Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, has invited online applications for one Security & GRC Lead post. The budget is a maximum of Rs. 39,67,678 a year (GST-inclusive), the experience required is 10–14 years, and the engagement is on contract initially for 3 years. Applications are open at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ and the last date is 30 November 2026.

The notice says the details can be downloaded from the official websites of DIC and NeGD, www.dic.gov.in and www.negd.gov.in.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: National e-Governance Division (NeGD), Digital India Corporation
Initially 3 years, extendable as per the requirement of the project
Screening of applications, then interview of shortlisted candidates

content_sections.heading: About NeGD
content_sections.text: NeGD is an independent business division under Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, located at Electronics Niketan, New Delhi. The notice says it supports MeitY in programme management and in implementing e-Governance projects of Central and State ministries and departments. Its initiatives named in the notice include DigiLocker, UMANG, Poshan Tracker, OpenForge Platform, API Setu, National Academic Depository, Academic Bank of Credits and Learning Management System.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification (one of the following, must have): B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering discipline, OR M.Tech./M.S. in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Applied Cryptography, or related field Certification (must have, required at deployment): at least one of CISSP, CISM, CEH, OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, or CompTIA Security+. Experience: 10–14 years. The notice also asks for: Strong experience in security architecture, governance, risk and compliance for environments handling sensitive PII at scale, such as payments, health data or govtech Hands-on security architecture experience; the notice says this is not a policy-only role Knowledge of DPDP Act obligations (Rules notified January 2025), CERT-In guidelines and zero-trust principles Ability to lead governance without needing to be the SOC operator or penetration tester ISO 27001 Lead Auditor and privacy certifications (DCPP, DPO training) Prior experience in public-sector or regulated programmes with Aadhaar, financial, or national-scale PII exposure The maximum age limit is 55 years on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice gives the budget for the post as a maximum of Rs. 39,67,678 a year (GST-inclusive). It does not mention HRA or other allowances. The position is purely on contract basis, initially for 3 years, further extendable as per the requirement of the project. The place of posting is New Delhi (on-site), but transferable to project locations of NeGD as per the existing policy of NeGD/DIC. The position is purely temporary for the project of NeGD/DIC. The appointee has no right or claim to permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC or on any vacancy advertised in future. NeGD reserves the right to terminate the appointment with one month's notice, or without notice by paying one month's salary in lieu of the notice period. The designation of the selected candidate will be mapped as per the existing designation policy of NeGD.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the role as part of the PMU for SIDH, which handles Aadhaar-linked identity, financial disbursements, learner PII and certification data across national schemes. Key responsibilities: Establish the platform security governance framework, cyber risk register, policy baseline and security architecture review process Own privacy and compliance leadership for DPDP Act controls, acting as the Data Protection Officer-equivalent function Lead rollout governance for procured-but-undeployed tools: Varonis (DSPM), Cymulate (BAS) and OPSWAT (DAP/CIP) Govern VAPT, application security testing, vulnerability management and remediation tracking across all vendors Drive zero-trust, access control, data classification and secure third-party access frameworks Coordinate with CERT-In, auditors, ministries and vendors on incidents, compliance and assurance Define security architecture sign-off requirements for integrations, APIs, identity flows, cloud controls and new services Activate WAF from monitoring-only to enforcement mode and drive closure of all AS-IS security gaps

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NeGD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates apply online at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ . The last date for submission of applications is 30 November 2026; the notice prints no time. The notice says the details can be downloaded from the official websites of DIC and NeGD, www.dic.gov.in and www.negd.gov.in . Document named in the notice: A No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies. Such candidates are expected to apply through proper channel or attach the certificate with the application, or produce it at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened on qualifications, age and relevant experience. NeGD reserves the right to fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience for screening and to limit the number of candidates called for interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview. The notice does not give the interview date, venue or mode.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NeGD reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the positions advertised, without assigning any reason. NeGD reserves the right not to select any candidate without assigning any reason. At least one of the listed certifications is required at deployment. For queries, contact the HR Team, National e Governance Division, 4th Floor, Electronics Niketan, 6-CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003, email [email protected] .
